note: Per-merge coverage trend. The merge list is scripts/todo-dashboard/timeline.json (the dashboard's timeline); after its last entry, the commits in the full reachable history that changed scripts/todo-dashboard/coverage-universe.json are appended from git. Each entry records the four numbers this page charts — measured rows, unmeasured rows, decided classes and the open false count — read from the metrics committed at that commit. A commit before the coverage page existed carries nulls, never zeros: a missing snapshot is not zero coverage. The false count is also null before CU-6, where the snapshot first measured its tier and register halves; the earlier value was a stub, not a zero. A trailing re-commit that leaves the four numbers unchanged is not repeated.
